chapter.verse: Tua hi a, Pasian' thukhualna tawh hih seppina a nei ka hih manun ka lungkia kei uh hi.

A zumhuai simtatnate paaikhia-in zuau khuak ahihkeileh Pasian' thu lumletna cihte tawh ka kalsuan kei uh a, thumaan thutak lahtelna tawh Pasian' mai ah mi khempeuh amau' kitheihtawmna lungsim a bun dingin komau' hihna hoih kong kipulak uh hi.
Tua hi a, kote' gen Lungdamna Thu a kiliah leh zong a kisia dingte' tungah a kiliah hizaw hi.
Tua bang a om leh hih khanghun a uk pasian in thu-umlote' lungsim a mialsak hizaw a, Pasian' limlemel ahi Khris ii a vangtaang Lungdamna Thu khuavak a muh loh nadingun a bawl ahi hi.
A hang pen komaumah a kitangkotawm ka hikei uh a, Jesu' hangin note' sila ka hihna uh hangin Jesu Khris pen Topa hi ci-in a tangko ka hi uh hi.
A hang pen, “Khuamial sungpan khuavak taang ta hen,” a ci Pasian in i lungsim sungah Jesu Khris' maitang tunga Pasian' vangtaang thu theihtelna khuavak hong taangsak khin hi.
Ahih hangin tehtheih loh vangliatna cih pen kote' a hilo, Pasian' a ahihlam lahkhiat nadingin hih leibeel sunga vanmanpha a nei ka hi uh hi.
A namcinin hong kinengcip a, ahi zongin ka zancip kei uh hi. Ka lungmang uh a, ahi zongin ka lungkia kei uh hi.
Hong kibawlsia a, ahi zongin hong kipaaidak lo hi. Hong kivatpaai a, ahi zongin ka si kei uh hi.
Ka pumpi uhah zong Jesu' nuntakna a kilatkhiat nadingin ka pumpi uh tawh Jesu' sihna ka pua tawntung uh hi.
A hang pen a sithei kote' cilesa sungah zong Jesu' nuntakna a kilatkhiat nadingin ko a nungtate in Jesu' adingin sihna khut sungah piak ka thuak tawntung uh hi.
Tua hi-in kote' sungah sihna gamtang a, note' sung ahihleh nuntakna gamtang hi.
“Ka um a, tua bangin ka gen hi,” ci-a kigelh thu tawh kizui-in tua upna Kha nei ka hih manun kote in zong ka um uh a, ka up bangun zong ka gen uh hi.
Jesu Topa a thokiksakpa in kote zong tua Jesu tawh kithuahin hong thokiksak dingin leh note tawh kithuahin ama' ompihna sungah hong tunpih ding cih ka thei uh hi.
A hang pen hihte khempeuh note' ading hi a, Pasian' minphat nadingin hehpihna in mi tampi ban semsemin lungdamkohna a khansak nading ahi hi.
Tua hangin ka lungkia kei uh a, ka pualam mi uh a zawmzawm ta ahih hangin ka sunglam mi uh ahihleh a nini-in a thaksuak ahi hi.
A hang pen hih a cihthamlo tomnokal gimthuakna in kote' adingin tehtheihloh tawntung minphatna lianpi khat hong piangkhiasak hi.
Kote in a kimuthei nate sangin a kimutheilo nate ka enzaw uh hi. A hang pen a kimuthei nate tomnokal bek hi a, a kimutheilo nate ahihleh a tawntungin a kip ahi hi.
